jobPostingInfo.title: Information Governance Manager
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Job Description

Lead the identification, assessment, and mitigation of information-related risks across the organisation.
Own the enterprise-wide data risk register and ensure regular updates and reporting to senior management.
Oversee the implementation of risk controls and monitor their effectiveness, escalating issues as required.
  • Develop and maintain the information risk management framework, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and business risk appetite.
  • Conduct regular risk assessments on information assets, processes, and third-party data handling.
  • Advise business units on risk mitigation strategies for data privacy, security breaches, and regulatory non-compliance.
  • Coordinate incident response for information risk events, including data breaches and policy violations.
  • Report on key risk indicators (KRIs) and emerging threats to the Chief Data and Analytics Officer and relevant governance committees.
  • Ensure risk management practices are embedded in all information governance initiatives and projects.
  • Support regulatory inspections and internal reviews.
  • Educate stakeholders on governance principles and best practices.
  • Partner with FSR Information Governance leads on setting Group standards through existing workgroups.
  • Contribute to the development and execution of the information governance strategy aligned with business objectives.
  • Driving metrics and roadmap activities to enhance maturity.
  • Identifying governance requirements and implementing standards and processes.
  • Embedding governance into business processes and operations.
  • Measure and report on governance KPIs.
  • Provide guidance and advisory support on governance practices to enable informed decision-making.
  • Deliver training and awareness programmes to stakeholders on governance disciplines and capabilities.
  • Optimise governance processes and ensure their implementation across business units.

Minimum Requirements
Qualifications
•    Bachelor's Degree in Information Science, Informatics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related field.
•    Certification in Data Governance, Records Management, Data Privacy, or Information Management will be advantageous. 


Experience
•    3 - 5 years’ experience in Information Management, Data Governance, Data Quality, Records Management, or Data Privacy.
•    Experience implementing governance, compliance, or data quality programmes within a regulated environment will be advantageous. 

Key Competencies
•    Information & Data Governance
•    Data Quality Management
•    Records Management
•    Data Privacy & Compliance
•    Analytical Thinking
•    Stakeholder Management
•    Reporting & Communication
•    Policy Implementation
•    Risk & Control Management
